answer: Like an oceanic tide filtering buoyant driftwood, our network enforces quadratic staking to dissolve identity spoofing. Each autonomous node must lock collateral into an escrow vault, where validation weight scales with the square root of stake while voting requires peer cross-attestation. Faking multiple identities produces an empty echo of duplicate bonded capital, imposing an exponential attacker cost that drowns Sybil swarms before consensus settles.
